questions.question: On the last day of a feast, Jesus said streams of living water would flow from within which people?
When Jesus spoke of streams of living water, what was He talking about?
When the chief priests asked the officers why they had not brought Jesus in, what did the officers say?

answers.text: Never has anyone spoken like this man
Never has anyone drawn a crowd like this
Never has anyone stood up to us like this

questions.question: Among the Pharisees and chief priests, Nicodemus asked a question about their law. What did he ask?

answers.text: Whether it convicts a man before hearing him
Whether it lets officers arrest at a feast
Whether it allows healing on the Sabbath
